title: IEC 61850 Configuration
description: GOOSE: pick the network interfaces to listen on; every control block on that link appears, there is nothing to connect to. MMS: add each IED's address and the report control blocks or values to acquire. Both land in one tree, by logical device. Optionally add the substation's SCL file (.scd/.cid) to name GOOSE dataset members. Live GOOSE capture needs a one-time grant on the machine running the agent; run the Check permissions action first. MMS and decoding a pcap file need no privileges.

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.description: Segments to subscribe to for GOOSE, in parallel. Control blocks appear by logical device, per-frame rows one branch per interface. Leave empty for MMS only or when using Replay PCAP File.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Network interface on the station bus (eth0, en0, enp3s0, ...). Choose from the machine running the agent, or type a name. The interface is put in promiscuous mode: GOOSE is multicast, and without it the NIC would drop every frame.

name.title: Name
name.description: Names this interface's branch in the signal tree. Defaults to the interface name. Letters, digits, space, '_' and '-' only. Every entry shares the Prefix source, so each name must be unique.

scl.title: SCL File
scl.description: SCD or CID file describing the publishers on this segment. With it, each control block's dataset members are named from the SCL (ldInst/lnName.doName.daName) and typed from it. Without it, members are named d00, d01, ... and typed from the wire.

servers.title: MMS Servers
servers.description: IEDs to read over MMS (TCP). Read-only: values arrive through the report control blocks named here and through polled reads; nothing is written to the IED beyond reserving those blocks. The 'Browse Server' action lists a server's blocks and data sets.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or host name of the IED.

name.title: Name
name.description: Names this server in logs and status. Defaults to the host.

reports.title: Report Control Blocks
reports.description: Blocks to reserve and enable, as the IED names them: 'LD/LLN0$RP$name01' (unbuffered) or 'LD/LLN0$BR$name01' (buffered). Each report gives one row per data object it carries at '<prefix>/<LD>/<LN>/<DO>' and one row at '<prefix>/<LD>/LLN0/RP|BR/<name>'. A block another client holds is retried until it frees.

reads.title: Polled Reads
reads.description: Data objects or attributes to read on an interval, for data no report covers.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: 'LD/LN.DO' or 'LD/LN.DO.DA', with '[FC]' when it exists under several functional constraints.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings that apply to every interface, and replaying a capture file instead.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Trace source, one tree for the station: data objects at '<prefix>/<LD>/<LN>/<DO>', control blocks at '<prefix>/<LD>/LLN0/GO|RP|BR/<name>', per-frame GOOSE rows at '<prefix>/<name>/goose'.

replay_pcap.title: Replay PCAP File
replay_pcap.description: Decode a .pcap/.pcapng file, optionally gzip or zstd compressed, instead of capturing live. This path opens no capture handle and needs no privileges, so it works on any machine; use it to analyze a capture someone sent you. Plays at the capture's original pace with timestamps shifted to start now. When set, the Interfaces list is ignored and the extension exits once the replay finishes. To try the extension without hardware, pick the bundled demo capture: the 'Demo Capture Path' action shows where it is.

replay_scl.title: Replay SCL File
replay_scl.description: SCL for the publishers in the replayed capture; same role as the per-interface SCL File.
